source_title: Ubique Group and Martha Stewart Introduce Martha Stewart's First Modular Living-Room Collection - PR Newswire
source_excerpt:
New Bedford and Lily Pond Collections make stylish living-room storage simple with configurable designs inspired by custom built-in cabinetry
CANTON, Ga. , Oct. 22, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Ubique Group, a leading provider of commercial and residential furniture, today announced the launch of Martha Stewart's first modular living room collection, developed in partnership with Martha Stewart and global brand accelerator Marquee Brands.
Featuring more than 75 individual components and thoughtfully coordinated kits, the new Martha Stewart Living Room Collection brings beauty, function and flexibility to one of the home's most lived-in spaces. The collection introduces two distinct design expressions, Bedford and Lily Pond, each offering configurable storage and entertainment furniture.
Together, the collections provide a stylish, approachable alternative to traditional custom cabinetry, combining the look of built-in woodwork with thoughtful craftsmanship and the flexibility of modular design, without the time, expense or commitment of a renovation.
With cabinets, hutches and TV stands that can be used independently or combined into larger arrangements, the collection makes it easy to create a solution suited to each room, household and way of living. From a streamlined media console to a complete wall of coordinated storage, every configuration reflects Martha's belief that an organized home should also be a beautiful one.
The Martha Stewart Bedford Collection takes its cues from Martha's own Bedford, New York farmhouse, offering two complementary expressions: a clean-lined Shaker profile for a classic, unadorned look, and fluted detailing for a more dimensional, architectural texture. Both bring character to media storage, display and organization, with a versatile aesthetic that complements a range of interiors.
The Martha Stewart Lily Pond Collection draws from Martha's East Hampton retreat, pairing clean-lined, inset-panel cabinetry with relaxed coastal simplicity for practical, everyday storage. Understated and enduring, Lily Pond offers an approachable foundation that feels equally at home in traditional, transitional and more relaxed interiors.
The Bedford and Lily Pond Collections offer a total of six finishes, solid wood frames and legs, soft-close hardware, and configurable cabinets, hutches and TV stands, including options designed for televisions up to 75 inches.
The pieces may be purchased individually to create a personalized arrangement or as coordinated kits that make it easier to achieve a complete, cohesive look. This modular approach allows the furniture to adapt as a room, storage need or household changes over time.
"This collection reflects everything we value about our partnership with Martha Stewart and Marquee Brands: elevated design, thoughtful function and solutions that make beautiful living more attainable," said Gabe Johnson, CEO of Ubique Group. "Bedford and Lily Pond give consumers the look and utility of custom built-ins with the flexibility to create a configuration truly suited to their homes. We are proud to expand our work with Martha into the living room with a collection that is as practical as it is beautiful."
Ubique Group is also expanding the Martha Stewart living-room assortment with a new Upholstery Collection, offering seating designed to complement the storage pieces and bring the room together. Its modular pieces feature solid wood frames and durable polyester upholstery, and can be mixed and matched to create a seating arrangement that evolves with your space and needs.
The Martha Stewart Bedford and Lily Pond Living Room Collections are available now through major online retailers, including Amazon, Wayfair, Target and other leading retail partners. Individual components and kits range in price from $425 to $2900.
Ubique Group is a leading omni-channel provider of commercial and residential furniture for home, office, classroom, event and commercial spaces worldwide. Backed by 25 years of world-class sales and service, Ubique Group delivers a broad assortment of high-quality furnishings at affordable prices. The company offers more than 4,000 unique, highly rated commercial and residential products with unparalleled marketplace distribution. Ubique Group is a portfolio company of Prospect Capital Corporation.
Prospect Capital Corporation (NASDAQ: PSEC ) ("Prospect") is a business development company that primarily lends to and invests in middle-market, privately held companies. Prospect's investment objective is to generate both current income and long-term capital appreciation.
Prospect has elected to be treated as a business development company under the Investment Company Act of 1940 and as a regulated investment company under the Internal Revenue Code of 1986.
Marquee Brands is the premier accelerator of timeless brands, unlocking value and building global influence. With a focus on driving growth and developing sustainable brand equity, Marquee partners with best-in-class manufacturers, operators, retailers and distributors to scale brands across markets and channels. Marquee Brands' global portfolio spans four distinct platforms: Luxury, Home & Culinary, Fashion & Lifestyle and Active & Outdoor. The portfolio of brands includes Roberto Cavalli, BCBGMAXAZRIA, Bruno Magli, A Pea in the Pod, Martha Stewart, Laura Ashley, Sur La Table, Emeril Lagasse, Cook's Country, Cook's Illustrated, America's Test Kitchen, Food52, Just Cavalli, BCBG, Ben Sherman, Roots*, Isotoner, Anti Social Social Club, Motherhood, Destination Maternity, Stance, Totes, Dakine and Body Glove. For more information visit, www.marqueebrands.com . (*Upon closing in Q4 2026.)
About Martha Stewart Martha Stewart is the founder of the first multi-channel lifestyle company, Martha Stewart Living Omnimedia, an entrepreneur, bestselling author of 102 lifestyle books, and Emmy Award-winning television show host. Reaching more than 100 million devoted fans monthly through multi-media platforms and products for the home, sold through Amazon.com and The World of Martha Stewart and an extensive retail network, Martha is the "go-to" authority on the encompassing topic of Living and Celebrating your best life. She and her talented staff provide trusted, timely, and useful information on all aspects of everyday living: cooking, entertaining, gardening, home renovating, collecting, organizing, crafting, healthy living, holidays, weddings, and pet care, across many media formats.
